messages:
maya: Heads up — discovered invoice INV-0731 from CloudRack mis-tagged. Negative pilot credit was applied to the experimental-pricing product instead of the hosted-api SKU. This will misstate our deferral buckets for the month if not fixed before close.

samir: Can you paste the invoice line items? is this a billing export issue or mapping rule problem?

maya: Copied invoice lines from Chargebee: 
```
INV-0731
1) Hosted API usage - 9,800 tokens @ $0.0006 = $5.88  (should be hosted-api)
2) Pilot credit -$5.88  (incorrectly tagged experimental-pricing)
```
The net is zero but the credit hit the wrong product, moving deferred revenue out of hosted-api into experimental.

lia: If the credit lives on experimental, our deferral schedule shifts categories. We should reclass the deferral entry. Jason — any objection to a manual JE before close?

jason: No objection. Draft JE below, post as reclassification before EOD: 
```
DR Deferred Revenue - Experimental (GL 2205)    5.88
CR Deferred Revenue - Hosted API (GL 2201)     5.88
```
Also update Chargebee attribution so downstream close systems pick up the right mapping next month.

maya: I updated the invoice metadata in Chargebee to hosted-api (changed product mapping). However the close extract already fed the close workbook, so we need the JE + a note in the close tracker.

accounting-bot: Automated notice: invoice INV-0731 updated by maya at 2024-06-12T11:02:00Z

samir: @jason please confirm GL codes. Do we consider any revenue impact or is this purely timing/reclassification?

jason: GLs 2201 (Deferred - Hosted API) and 2205 (Deferred - Experimental) are correct. This is a balance-sheet reclass only — no P&L impact. Post as a normal reclassification JE and tag as month-end adjustment.

lia: :thumbsup: I'll note it in the month-close tracker and attach the updated Chargebee invoice PDF. @product-ops can you add a rule so future pilot credits with tag "pilot-credit" map to hosted-api when invoice contains hosted usage?

product-ops: Will set a mapping rule. Quick question: are there edge cases where an experimental credit should stay on the experimental bucket?

samir: Good call — we'll add a condition: if invoice contains hosted-api usage lines > 0 then pilot-credit maps to hosted-api; else leave as experimental. I'll push the rule today.

maya: Thanks everyone. Jason, once you post the JE drop the JE number here.

jason: Posted JE #2024-06-CL-4579. Marked as "post-close reclass" in the workbook and added a short memo for audit.

maya: :white_check_mark: Verified entry present in the close file and updated the SOC2 notes. Closing the thread.
